_contract: The project's permanent evaluation sets. A set's bytes are verified against the LAST identity in its identity_history; a protected set (candidate, frozen) gains a new identity only by appending an entry that cites a maintainer authorization. New evaluation needs are added as new sets (eval-set-2, ...), never by rewriting an old one. AUTHORIZES NOTHING.

statuses.frozen: declared frozen by the maintainer; protected
statuses.retired: kept for history; not read by new work
